profile_text.body:
Goblin Tools is an independent developer behind the tool of the same name, hosted at goblin.tools. According to its own site, the tool now offers accounts, which the site says let users keep their history, sync lists across devices, and share them with anyone.

The product is tracked as an education and research AI tool. Its AI function is described as task breakdown, and its uses are task breakdown and tone tools, aimed at students and adults. The web version needs no account, and the web version is free, while the mobile app costs $2.99 one-time on the App Store. The tool is described as designed for neurodivergent users and as a consumer tool, with privacy not verified and no school agreement in place.
